{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_011FMd7PnL6JhfGsDKiEb77A","type":"tool_result","content":[{"type":"text","text":"### Build Image Gallery with State Management\n\nSource: https://github.com/context7/18_react_dev/blob/main/learn/adding-interactivity.md\n\nDemonstrates a complete image gallery component using useState for managing current image index and detail visibility. The component handles user interactions through click handlers that update state, and conditionally renders content based on state values. Imports from external data file and manages multiple state variables.\n\n```jsx\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { sculptureList } from './data.js';\n\nexport default function Gallery() {\n  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);\n  const [showMore, setShowMore] = useState(false);\n  const hasNext = index < sculptureList.length - 1;\n\n  function handleNextClick() {\n    if (hasNext) {\n      setIndex(index + 1);\n    } else {\n      setIndex(0);\n    }\n  }\n\n  function handleMoreClick() {\n    setShowMore(!showMore);\n  }\n\n  let sculpture = sculptureList[index];\n  return (\n    <>\n      <button onClick={handleNextClick}>\n        Next\n      </button>\n      <h2>\n        <i>{sculpture.name} </i>\n        by {sculpture.artist}\n      </h2>\n      <h3>\n        ({index + 1} of {sculptureList.length})\n      </h3>\n      <button onClick={handleMoreClick}>\n        {showMore ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} details\n      </button>\n      {showMore && <p>{sculpture.description}</p>}\n      <img\n        src={sculpture.url}\n        alt={sculpture.alt}\n      />\n    </>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Scrolling to Specific Images with Multiple Refs in React\n\nSource: https://github.com/context7/18_react_dev/blob/main/learn/manipulating-the-dom-with-refs.md\n\nThis example showcases managing multiple refs within a single React component to scroll to different images. By default, Spring Boot configures Spring MVC with a maximum size of 1MB per file and a maximum of 10MB of file data in a single request. You may override these values, the location to which intermediate data is stored (for example, to the `/tmp` directory), and the threshold past which data is flushed to disk by using the properties exposed in the `MultipartProperties` class. For example, if you want to specify that files be unlimited, set the `spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size` property to `-1`.\nThe multipart support is helpful when you want to receive multipart encoded file data as a `@RequestParam`-annotated parameter of type `MultipartFile` in a Spring MVC controller handler method.\nSee the `MultipartAutoConfiguration` source for more details.\n__ |  It is recommended to use the container’s built-in support for multipart uploads rather than introduce an additional dependency such as Apache Commons File Upload.   \n---|---"}]}

It simplifies the component's logic by abstracting the effect into the hook. The component still manages its own state (serverUrl) and passes the necessary props to the custom hook. Requires React's useState and the custom 'useChatRoom' hook.\n\n```javascript\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useChatRoom } from './useChatRoom.js';\n\nfunction ChatRoom({ roomId }) {\n  const [serverUrl, setServerUrl] = useState('https://localhost:1234');\n\n  useChatRoom({\n    roomId: roomId,\n    serverUrl: serverUrl\n  });\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <label>\n        Server URL:{' '}\n        <input\n          value={serverUrl}\n          onChange={e => setServerUrl(e.target.value)}\n        />\n      </label>\n      <h1>Welcome to the {roomId} room!</h1>\n    </>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function App() {\n  const [roomId, setRoomId] = useState('general');\n  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <>\n      <label>\n        Choose the chat room:{' '}\n        <select\n          value={roomId}\n          onChange={e => setRoomId(e.target.value)}\n        >\n          <option value=\"general\">general</option>\n          <option value=\"travel\">travel</option>\n          <option value=\"music\">music</option>\n        </select>\n      </label>\n      <button onClick={() => setShow(!show)}>\n        {show ? It accepts serverUrl and roomId as arguments and handles the connection and disconnection lifecycle. This promotes reusability and separation of concerns. It requires React's useState and useEffect hooks.\n\n```javascript\nfunction useChatRoom({ serverUrl, roomId }) {  \n  useEffect(() => {  \n    const options = {  \n      serverUrl: serverUrl,  \n      roomId: roomId  \n    };\n    const connection = createConnection(options);  \n    connection.connect();  \n    return () => connection.disconnect();  \n  }, [roomId, serverUrl]);  \n}\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### React Custom Hook for Idempotent Time Display\n\nSource: https://github.com/context7/react_dev_reference/blob/main/rules/components-and-hooks-must-be-pure.md\n\nThis custom React hook `useTime` ensures idempotency by using `useState` with an initializer function and `useEffect` to update the date. The non-idempotent `new Date()` call is moved inside `useEffect`, preventing it from running during render. It also includes cleanup for the `setInterval` timer.\n\n```javascript\nimport { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\n\nfunction useTime() {\n  // 1. Keep track of the current date's state. `useState` receives an initializer function as its\n  //    initial state. It only runs once when the hook is called, so only the current date at the\n  //    time the hook is called is set first.\n  const [time, setTime] = useState(() => new Date());\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    // 2. Update the current date every second using `setInterval`.\n    const id = setInterval(() => {\n      setTime(new Date()); // ✅ Good: non-idempotent code no longer runs in render\n    }, 1000);\n    // 3. Return a cleanup function so we don't leak the `setInterval` timer.\n    return () => clearInterval(id);\n  }, []);\n\n  return time;\n}\n\nexport default function Clock() {\n  const time = useTime();\n  return <span>{time.toLocaleString()}</span>;\n}\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### useContext Hook for Accessing Context in React\n\nSource: https://github.com/context7/react_dev_reference/blob/main/react/hooks.md\n\nThe `useContext` hook allows a component to read and subscribe to a context. This is useful for passing data deep down the component tree without prop drilling. It accepts a Context object and returns the current context value for that context.\n\n```javascript\nfunction Button() {\n  const theme = useContext(ThemeContext);\n  // ...\n}\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Example: Updating Context Value\n\nSource: https://github.com/context7/react_dev_reference/blob/main/react/useContext.md\n\nProvides a practical example of updating a context value through state management. It also includes cleanup for the `setInterval` timer.\n\n```javascript\nimport { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\n\nfunction useTime() {\n  // 1. Configures AsyncTaskExecutor with virtual threads enabled and demonstrates the @Async annotation for non-blocking operations. The example includes a REST endpoint that handles asynchronous requests, returning CompletableFuture for async processing with automatic virtual thread management.\n\n```java\nimport org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;\nimport org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;\nimport org.springframework.boot.task.SimpleAsyncTaskExecutorBuilder;\nimport org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;\nimport org.springframework.core.task.AsyncTaskExecutor;\nimport org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async;\nimport org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.EnableAsync;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;\n\nimport java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;\n\n@SpringBootApplication\n@EnableAsync\npublic class VirtualThreadsApplication {\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        SpringApplication.run(VirtualThreadsApplication.class, args);\n    }\n\n    @Bean\n    public AsyncTaskExecutor applicationTaskExecutor(SimpleAsyncTaskExecutorBuilder builder) {\n        return builder\n            .virtualThreads(true)\n            .threadNamePrefix(\"vthread-\")\n            .build();\n    }\n}\n\n@Service\nclass AsyncService {\n\n    @Async\n    public CompletableFuture<String> performAsyncTask(String input) {\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(1000);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n        }\n        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(\"Processed: \" + input);\n    }\n}\n\n@RestController\nclass VirtualThreadController {\n\n    private final AsyncService asyncService;\n\n    VirtualThreadController(AsyncService asyncService) {\n        this.asyncService = asyncService;\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/async\")\n    public CompletableFuture<String> handleAsync() {\n        return asyncService.performAsyncTask(\"request-data\");\n    }\n}\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Disable the Embedded Web Server\n\nSource: https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/blob/v4.0.0/documentation/spring-boot-docs/src/docs/antora/modules/how-to/pages/webserver.adoc\n\nConfigures Spring Boot to disable the automatic startup of the embedded web server by setting the web-application-type property to 'none'. This is useful when you need a Spring application context without an HTTP server, such as for background job processing or testing scenarios.\n\n```yaml\nspring:\n  main:\n    web-application-type: \"none\"\n```\n\n### Virtual Threads Support > Modern Concurrency > Implementation Pattern\n\nSource: https://context7.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/llms.txt\n\nVirtual threads can be enabled in Spring Boot applications through configuration and integrated with the async task executor framework. By configuring the `SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor` with virtual threads enabled, developers can annotate methods with `@Async` to have them automatically execute on virtual threads. This approach provides a bridge between traditional imperative programming models and the scalability benefits of virtual thread concurrency, allowing gradual adoption without rewriting entire applications to use reactive frameworks.\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Virtual Threads Support > Modern Concurrency > Benefits\n\nSource: https://context7.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/llms.txt\n\nSpring Boot 4.0 introduces first-class support for Java virtual threads, enabling highly scalable applications with simplified concurrency patterns. Virtual threads dramatically reduce resource consumption for I/O-bound workloads by allowing thousands of concurrent operations without the overhead of traditional platform threads. This makes it possible to build applications that can handle massive concurrency levels while maintaining clean, straightforward code that doesn't require complex reactive programming paradigms.\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### File Handling > Multipart File Uploads\n\nSource: https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/blob/v4.0.0/documentation/spring-boot-docs/src/docs/antora/modules/how-to/pages/spring-mvc.adoc\n\nSpring Boot embraces the servlet 5 Part API to support uploading files. file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n    file_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'CBR' or 'CBZ'\n    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    page_count INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    cover_image_path TEXT,\n    uploaded_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- User reading progress (last page only)\nCREATE TABLE reading_progress (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    current_page INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- User ratings\nCREATE TABLE ratings (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5),\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- TTS processing jobs\nCREATE TABLE tts_jobs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    requested_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED\n    progress INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 0-100\n    current_page INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    error_message TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- TTS results stored as JSON in SQLite\nCREATE TABLE tts_results (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    page_number INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    ocr_text TEXT, -- Raw extracted text\n    speakers_json TEXT, -- JSON: [{\"speaker\": \"narrator\", \"text\": \"...\", \"audio_path\": \"...\"}]\n    audio_file_path TEXT, -- Combined audio for the page\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(file_id, page_number)\n);\n\n-- LLM Configuration (admin-managed)\nCREATE TABLE llm_config (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    provider TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'openai', 'claude', 'minimax'\n    api_key_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,\n    model_name TEXT,\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n    priority INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- For fallback ordering\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- Audit logs\nCREATE TABLE audit_logs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    action TEXT NOT NULL,\n    entity_type TEXT,\n    entity_id INTEGER,\n    details TEXT, -- JSON\n    ip_address TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- System logs\nCREATE TABLE system_logs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    level TEXT NOT NULL, -- INFO, WARN, ERROR\n    message TEXT NOT NULL,\n    stack_trace TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n```\n\n### API Endpoints (REST)\n\n```\nAuthentication:\nPOST   /api/auth/login          - Login with username/password\nPOST   /api/auth/logout         - Logout (invalidate session)\nPOST   /api/auth/register       - Register new user\nGET    /api/auth/me             - Get current user user's rating for file\nPOST   /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Rate a file (1-5)\nGET    /api/ratings/{fileId}/avg    - Get average rating\n\nTTS Processing:\nPOST   /api/tts/request/{fileId}    - /api/tts/audio/{fileId}/{page} - Stream audio for specific page\n\nAdmin:\nGET    /api/admin/users             - List users\nPOST   /api/admin/users             - Create user\nPUT Related Code Context\n\nSince this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n\n### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n\n**REST Controller Pattern:**\n```java\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\npublic class FileController {\n    private final FileService fileService;\n\n    @GetMapping\n    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n        return fileService.findById(id)\n            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n```java\n@Service\n@EnableAsync\npublic class TtsService {\n    @Async\n    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n        // For each page:\n        //   1. Extract image from archive\n        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n        //   5. Store result\n        //   6. Update progress\n        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n\n**Slice Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n\nexport const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n  'files/fetchAll',\n  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/files');\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n    }\n  }\n);\n\nconst filesSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'files',\n  initialState: {\n    items: [],\n    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n    error: null,\n  },\n  reducers: {},\n  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n    builder\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n        state.status = 'loading';\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'succeeded';\n        state.items = action.payload;\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'failed';\n        state.error = action.payload;\n      });\n  },\n});\n```\n\n**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n\nconst theme = createTheme({\n  palette: {\n    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n  },\n  components: {\n    MuiButton: {\n      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n    },\n  },\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n\n### Authentication & Authorization\n- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n- [ ] Session is maintained via TTS job with PENDING status\n- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n\n### Admin Panel\n- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n\n### Error Handling\n- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n- [ ] File not found returns 404\n- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n\n### Performance\n- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n\n---\n\n## 4.1 Guardrails (optional)\n```\n\n### Database Schema (SQLite)\n\n```sql\n-- Users table\nCREATE TABLE users (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER', -- 'USER' or 'ADMIN'\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- Comic files metadata\nCREATE TABLE comic_files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    filename TEXT NOT NULL,\n    original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,\n    file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n    file_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'CBR' or 'CBZ'\n    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    page_count INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    cover_image_path TEXT,\n    uploaded_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- User reading progress (last page only)\nCREATE TABLE reading_progress (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    current_page INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- User ratings\nCREATE TABLE ratings (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5),\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- TTS processing jobs\nCREATE TABLE tts_jobs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    requested_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED\n    progress INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 0-100\n    current_page INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    error_message TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- TTS results stored as JSON in SQLite\nCREATE TABLE tts_results (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    page_number INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    ocr_text TEXT, -- Raw extracted text\n    speakers_json TEXT, -- JSON: [{\"speaker\": \"narrator\", \"text\": \"...\", \"audio_path\": \"...\"}]\n    audio_file_path TEXT, -- Combined audio for the page\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(file_id, page_number)\n);\n\n-- LLM Configuration (admin-managed)\nCREATE TABLE llm_config (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    provider TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'openai', 'claude', 'minimax'\n    api_key_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,\n    model_name TEXT,\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n    priority INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- For fallback ordering\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- Audit logs\nCREATE TABLE audit_logs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    action TEXT NOT NULL,\n    entity_type TEXT,\n    entity_id INTEGER,\n    details TEXT, -- JSON\n    ip_address TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- System logs\nCREATE TABLE system_logs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    level TEXT NOT NULL, -- INFO, WARN, ERROR\n    message TEXT NOT NULL,\n    stack_trace TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n```\n\n### API Endpoints (REST)\n\n```\nAuthentication:\nPOST   /api/auth/login          - Login with username/password\nPOST   /api/auth/logout         - Logout (invalidate session)\nPOST   /api/auth/register       - Register new user\nGET    /api/auth/me             - Get current user info\n\nFiles:\nGET    /api/files               - List all files (paginated)\nGET    /api/files/{id}          - Get file metadata\nGET    /api/files/{id}/page/{n} - Get page image (extracted on-the-fly)\nGET    /api/files/{id}/cover    - Get cover image\nPOST   /api/files               - Upload new file (multipart)\nDELETE /api/files/{id}          - Delete file (admin only)\n\nReading Progress:\nGET    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Get current reading position\nPUT    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Update reading position\n\nRatings:\nGET    /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Get user's rating for file\nPOST   /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Rate a file (1-5)\nGET    /api/ratings/{fileId}/avg    - Get average rating\n\nTTS Processing:\nPOST   /api/tts/request/{fileId}    - Request TTS processing for file\nGET    /api/tts/status/{jobId}      - Get job status and progress\nGET    /api/tts/result/{fileId}     - Get TTS results for file\nGET    /api/tts/audio/{fileId}/{page} - Stream audio for specific page\n\nAdmin:\nGET    /api/admin/users             - List users\nPOST   /api/admin/users             - Create user\nPUT    /api/admin/users/{id}        - Update user\nDELETE /api/admin/users/{id}        - Delete user\nGET    /api/admin/files             - List all files (admin view)\nGET    /api/admin/logs              - Get system logs\nGET    /api/admin/audit             - Get audit logs\nGET    /api/admin/llm-config        - Get LLM configurations\nPUT    /api/admin/llm-config/{id}   - Update LLM configuration\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Related Code Context\n\nSince this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n\n### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n\n**REST Controller Pattern:**\n```java\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\npublic class FileController {\n    private final FileService fileService;\n\n    @GetMapping\n    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n        return fileService.findById(id)\n            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n```java\n@Service\n@EnableAsync\npublic class TtsService {\n    @Async\n    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n        // For each page:\n        //   1. Extract image from archive\n        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n        //   5. Store result\n        //   6. Update progress\n        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n\n**Slice Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n\nexport const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n  'files/fetchAll',\n  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/files');\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n    }\n  }\n);\n\nconst filesSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'files',\n  initialState: {\n    items: [],\n    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n    error: null,\n  },\n  reducers: {},\n  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n    builder\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n        state.status = 'loading';\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'succeeded';\n        state.items = action.payload;\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'failed';\n        state.error = action.payload;\n      });\n  },\n});\n```\n\n**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n\nconst theme = createTheme({\n  palette: {\n    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n  },\n  components: {\n    MuiButton: {\n      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n    },\n  },\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n\n### Authentication & Authorization\n- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n\n### File Management\n- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n\n### Viewing\n- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n\n### Reading Progress\n- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n\n### Ratings\n- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n\n### TTS Processing\n- [ ] User clicks \"Generate Audio\" button to request TTS\n- [ ] System creates TTS job with PENDING status\n- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n\n### Admin Panel\n- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n\n### Error Handling\n- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n- [ ] File not found returns 404\n- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n\n### Performance\n- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n\n---\n\n## 4.1 Guardrails (Prohibitions)\n\n### Scope Guardrails\n- [ ] DO NOT implement features not listed above (no scope creep)\n- [ ] DO NOT add OAuth/SSO - only session-based auth was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT add WebSocket for progress - use polling (REST API chosen)\n- [ ] DO NOT add E2E tests - only unit + integration tests\n- [ ] DO NOT add Docker/containerization unless explicitly requested later\n\n### Architecture Guardrails\n- [ ] DO NOT use JWT tokens - session-based auth was explicitly chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT use React Context for state - Redux Toolkit was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT pre-extract files on upload - on-the-fly extraction was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT store TTS results in separate files - JSON in SQLite was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT add Nginx/CDN - Spring Boot serves everything for MVP\n\n### Code Quality Guardrails\n- [ ] DO NOT create unnecessary abstractions\n- [ ] DO NOT add comments to obvious code\n- [ ] DO NOT add unused dependencies\n- [ ] AVOID over-engineering the LLM fallback (simple try-catch is enough)\n\n### Security Guardrails\n- [ ] NEVER store API keys in plain text - encrypt in database\n- [ ] NEVER expose stack traces to frontend - log and return generic error\n- [ ] NEVER trust user input - validate all inputs\n- [ ] NEVER store passwords in plain text - use bcrypt or similar\n- [ ] DO NOT disable CSRF protection for session-based auth\n\n---\n\n## 5. Verification and Traceability\n\nEach requirement from INITIAL_PROMPT.md must be verifiable:\n\n| Requirement | Verification Method |\n|-------------|---------------------|\n| CBR/CBZ viewing | Open file, verify pages render correctly |\n| Fullscreen mode | Click fullscreen button, verify browser fullscreen |\n| Scrolling mode | Switch to scroll mode, verify all pages load on scroll |\n| Page-by-page mode | Navigate with arrows, verify single page display |\n| Remember positions | Close and reopen file, verify resume position |\n| Rate files | Rate a file, refresh, verify rating persisted |\n| TTS on-demand | Click generate audio, verify job created |\n| LLM OCR | Check TTS result JSON contains extracted text |\n| Speaker identification | Verify speakers_json contains speaker labels |\n| Minimax TTS | Play audio, verify speech output |\n| Results stored | Query database, verify tts_results populated |\n| Admin user management | Create/edit/delete user in admin panel |\n| Admin file management | Upload/delete files in admin panel |\n| Admin logs | View logs in admin panel, verify entries |\n| Admin audit logs | Perform actions, verify audit log entries |\n| Admin LLM config | Update API keys, verify saved |\n| Session-based auth | Login, verify cookie set, logout, verify session invalid |\n\n---\n\n## 7. Reasoning Boundaries\n\n### Follow Existing Patterns\n- Use standard Spring Boot controller/service/repository layering\n- Use Redux Toolkit best practices (slices, async thunks)\n- Use MUI components and theming system\n\n### Avoid Over-Engineering\n- Simple try-catch for LLM fallback, no complex circuit breaker\n- In-memory cache for pages is sufficient (no Redis for MVP)\n- SQLite is adequate for single-server deployment\n- No microservices, keep monolithic\n\n### When Uncertain\n- If OCR prompt doesn't work well, iterate on prompt engineering\n- If Minimax API has issues, document in error message\n- If performance is slow, add indexes to SQLite first\n\n### Boundaries\n- Do NOT implement real-time WebSocket updates (polling is sufficient)\n- Do NOT implement multi-language support initially\n- Do NOT implement file sharing between users\n- Do NOT implement comments or social features\n- Do NOT implement cloud storage (disk only for MVP)\n\n---\n\n## 8. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n   313→\n   314→### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n   315→\n   316→**REST Controller Pattern:**\n   317→```java\n   318→@RestController\n   319→@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\n   320→public class FileController {\n   321→    private final FileService fileService;\n   322→\n   323→    @GetMapping\n   324→    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n   325→        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n   326→    }\n   327→\n   328→    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n   329→    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n   330→        return fileService.findById(id)\n   331→            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n   332→            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n   333→    }\n   334→\n   335→    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n   336→    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n   337→        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n   338→            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n   339→    }\n   340→}\n   341→```\n   342→\n   343→**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n   344→```java\n   345→@Service\n   346→@EnableAsync\n   347→public class TtsService {\n   348→    @Async\n   349→    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n   350→        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n   351→        // For each page:\n   352→        //   1. Extract image from archive\n   353→        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n   354→        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n   355→        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n   356→        //   5. Store result\n   357→        //   6. Update progress\n   358→        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n   359→        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n   360→    }\n   361→}\n   362→```\n   363→\n   364→### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n   365→\n   366→**Slice Pattern:**\n   367→```typescript\n   368→import { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n   369→\n   370→export const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n   371→  'files/fetchAll',\n   372→  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n   373→    try {\n   374→      const response = await api.get('/files');\n   375→      return response.data;\n   376→    } catch (error) {\n   377→      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n   378→    }\n   379→  }\n   380→);\n   381→\n   382→const filesSlice = createSlice({\n   383→  name: 'files',\n   384→  initialState: {\n   385→    items: [],\n   386→    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n   387→    error: null,\n   388→  },\n   389→  reducers: {},\n   390→  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n   391→    builder\n   392→      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n   393→        state.status = 'loading';\n   394→      })\n   395→      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n   396→        state.status = 'succeeded';\n   397→        state.items = action.payload;\n   398→      })\n   399→      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n   400→        state.status = 'failed';\n   401→        state.error = action.payload;\n   402→      });\n   403→  },\n   404→});\n   405→```\n Acceptance Criteria\n   428→\n   429→### Authentication & Authorization\n   430→- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n   431→- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n   432→- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n   433→- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n   434→- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n   435→- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n   436→- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n   437→\n   438→### File Management\n   439→- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n   440→- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n   441→- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n   442→- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n   443→- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n   444→- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n   445→- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n   446→\n   447→### Viewing\n   448→- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n   449→- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n   450→- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n   451→- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n   452→- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n   453→- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n   454→\n   455→### Reading Progress\n   456→- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n   457→- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n   458→- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n   459→- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n   460→\n   461→### Ratings\n   462→- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n   463→- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n   464→- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n   465→- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n   466→\n   467→### TTS Processing\n   468→- [ ] User NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- User ratings\nCREATE TABLE ratings (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5),\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- TTS processing jobs\nCREATE TABLE tts_jobs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    requested_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED\n    progress INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 0-100\n    current_page INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    error_message TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- TTS results stored as JSON in SQLite\nCREATE TABLE tts_results (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    page_number INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    ocr_text TEXT, -- Raw extracted text\n    speakers_json TEXT, -- JSON: [{\"speaker\": \"narrator\", \"text\": \"...\", \"audio_path\": \"...\"}]\n    audio_file_path TEXT, -- Combined audio for the page\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(file_id, page_number)\n);\n\n-- LLM Configuration (admin-managed)\nCREATE TABLE llm_config (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    provider TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'openai', 'claude', 'minimax'\n    api_key_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,\n    model_name TEXT,\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n    priority INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- For fallback ordering\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- Audit logs\nCREATE TABLE audit_logs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    action TEXT NOT NULL,\n    entity_type TEXT,\n    entity_id INTEGER,\n    details TEXT, -- JSON\n    ip_address TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- System logs\nCREATE TABLE system_logs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    level TEXT NOT NULL, -- INFO, WARN, ERROR\n    message TEXT NOT NULL,\n    stack_trace TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n```\n\n### API Endpoints (REST)\n\n```\nAuthentication:\nPOST   /api/auth/login          - Login with username/password\nPOST   /api/auth/logout         - Logout (invalidate session)\nPOST   /api/auth/register       - Register new user\nGET    /api/auth/me             - Get current user user's rating for file\nPOST   /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Rate a file (1-5)\nGET    /api/ratings/{fileId}/avg    - Get average rating\n\nTTS Processing:\nPOST   /api/tts/request/{fileId}    - configuration\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Related Code Context\n\nSince this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n\n### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n\n**REST Controller Pattern:**\n```java\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\npublic class FileController {\n    private final FileService fileService;\n\n    @GetMapping\n    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n        return fileService.findById(id)\n            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n```java\n@Service\n@EnableAsync\npublic class TtsService {\n    @Async\n    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n        // For each page:\n        //   1. Extract image from archive\n        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n        //   5. Store result\n        //   6. Update progress\n        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n\n**Slice Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n\nexport const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n  'files/fetchAll',\n  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/files');\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n    }\n  }\n);\n\nconst filesSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'files',\n  initialState: {\n    items: [],\n    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n    error: null,\n  },\n  reducers: {},\n  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n    builder\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n        state.status = 'loading';\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'succeeded';\n        state.items = action.payload;\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'failed';\n        state.error = action.payload;\n      });\n  },\n});\n```\n\n**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n\nconst theme = createTheme({\n  palette: {\n    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n  },\n  components: {\n    MuiButton: {\n      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n    },\n  },\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n\n### Authentication & Authorization\n- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n\n### File Management\n- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n\n### Viewing\n- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n\n### Reading Progress\n- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n\n### Ratings\n- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n\n### TTS Processing\n- [ ] User clicks \"Generate Audio\" button to request TTS\n- [ ] System creates TTS job with PENDING status\n- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n\n### Admin Panel\n- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n\n### Error Handling\n- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n- [ ] File not found returns 404\n- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n\n### Performance\n- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n\n---\n\n## 4.1 Guardrails Reasoning Boundaries\n\n### Follow Existing Patterns\n- Use standard Spring Boot controller/service/repository layering\n- Use Redux Toolkit best practices (slices, async thunks)\n- Use MUI components and theming system\n\n### Avoid Over-Engineering\n- Simple try-catch for LLM fallback, no complex circuit breaker\n- In-memory cache for pages is sufficient (no Redis for MVP)\n- SQLite is adequate for single-server deployment\n- No microservices, keep monolithic\n\n### When Uncertain\n- If OCR prompt doesn't work well, iterate on prompt engineering\n- If Minimax API has issues, document in error message\n- If performance is slow, add indexes to SQLite first\n\n### Boundaries\n- Do NOT implement real-time WebSocket updates (polling is sufficient)\n- Do NOT implement multi-language support initially\n- Do NOT implement file sharing between users\n- Do NOT implement comments or social features\n- Do NOT implement cloud storage (disk only for MVP)\n\n---\n\n## 8. Related Code Context\n   311→\n   312→Since this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n   313→\n   314→### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n   315→\n   316→**REST Controller Pattern:**\n   317→```java\n   318→@RestController\n   319→@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\n   320→public class FileController {\n   321→    private final FileService fileService;\n   322→\n   323→    @GetMapping\n   324→    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n   325→        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n   326→    }\n   327→\n   328→    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n   329→    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n   330→        return fileService.findById(id)\n   331→            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n   332→            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n   333→    }\n   334→\n   335→    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n   336→    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n   337→        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n   338→            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n   339→    }\n   340→}\n   341→```\n   342→\n   343→**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n   344→```java\n   345→@Service\n   346→@EnableAsync\n   347→public class TtsService {\n   348→    @Async\n   349→    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n   350→        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n   351→        // For each page:\n   352→        //   1. Extract image from archive\n   353→        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n   354→        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n   355→        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n   356→        //   5. Store result\n   357→        //   6. .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n   396→        state.status = 'succeeded';\n   397→        state.items = action.payload;\n   398→      })\n   399→      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n   400→        state.status = 'failed';\n   401→        state.error = action.payload;\n   402→      });\n   403→  },\n   404→});\n   405→```\n (optional)\n```\n\n### Database Schema (SQLite)\n\n```sql\n-- Users table\nCREATE TABLE users (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER', -- 'USER' or 'ADMIN'\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- Comic files metadata\nCREATE TABLE comic_files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    filename TEXT NOT NULL,\n    original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,\n    file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n    file_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'CBR' or 'CBZ'\n    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    page_count INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    cover_image_path TEXT,\n    uploaded_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- User reading progress (last page only)\nCREATE TABLE reading_progress (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    current_page INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- User ratings\nCREATE TABLE ratings (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5),\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- TTS processing jobs\nCREATE TABLE tts_jobs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    requested_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED\n    progress INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 0-100\n    current_page INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    error_message TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- TTS results stored as JSON in SQLite\nCREATE TABLE tts_results (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n    page_number INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    ocr_text TEXT, -- Raw extracted text\n    speakers_json TEXT, -- JSON: [{\"speaker\": \"narrator\", \"text\": \"...\", \"audio_path\": \"...\"}]\n    audio_file_path TEXT, -- Combined audio for the page\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE(file_id, page_number)\n);\n\n-- LLM Configuration (admin-managed)\nCREATE TABLE llm_config (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    provider TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'openai', 'claude', 'minimax'\n    api_key_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,\n    model_name TEXT,\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n    priority INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- For fallback ordering\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- Audit logs\nCREATE TABLE audit_logs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    action TEXT NOT NULL,\n    entity_type TEXT,\n    entity_id INTEGER,\n    details TEXT, -- JSON\n    ip_address TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- System logs\nCREATE TABLE system_logs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    level TEXT NOT NULL, -- INFO, WARN, ERROR\n    message TEXT NOT NULL,\n    stack_trace TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n```\n\n### API Endpoints (REST)\n\n```\nAuthentication:\nPOST   /api/auth/login          - Login with username/password\nPOST   /api/auth/logout         - Logout (invalidate session)\nPOST   /api/auth/register       - Register new user\nGET    /api/auth/me             - Get current user info\n\nFiles:\nGET    /api/files               - List all files (paginated)\nGET    /api/files/{id}          - Get file metadata\nGET    /api/files/{id}/page/{n} - Get page image (extracted on-the-fly)\nGET    /api/files/{id}/cover    - Get cover image\nPOST   /api/files               - Upload new file (multipart)\nDELETE /api/files/{id}          - Delete file (admin only)\n\nReading Progress:\nGET    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Get current reading position\nPUT    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Update reading position\n\nRatings:\nGET    /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Get user's rating for file\nPOST   /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Rate a file (1-5)\nGET    /api/ratings/{fileId}/avg    - Get average rating\n\nTTS Processing:\nPOST   /api/tts/request/{fileId}    - Request TTS processing for file\nGET    /api/tts/status/{jobId}      - Get job status and progress\nGET    /api/tts/result/{fileId}     - Get TTS results for file\nGET    /api/tts/audio/{fileId}/{page} - Stream audio for specific page\n\nAdmin:\nGET    /api/admin/users             - List users\nPOST   /api/admin/users             - Create user\nPUT    /api/admin/users/{id}        - Update user\nDELETE /api/admin/users/{id}        - Delete user\nGET    /api/admin/files             - List all files (admin view)\nGET    /api/admin/logs              - Get system logs\nGET    /api/admin/audit             - Get audit logs\nGET    /api/admin/llm-config        - Get LLM configurations\nPUT    /api/admin/llm-config/{id}   - Update LLM configuration\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Related Code Context\n\nSince this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n\n### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n\n**REST Controller Pattern:**\n```java\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\npublic class FileController {\n    private final FileService fileService;\n\n    @GetMapping\n    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n        return fileService.findById(id)\n            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n```java\n@Service\n@EnableAsync\npublic class TtsService {\n    @Async\n    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n        // For each page:\n        //   1. Extract image from archive\n        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n        //   5. Store result\n        //   6. Update progress\n        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n\n**Slice Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n\nexport const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n  'files/fetchAll',\n  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/files');\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n    }\n  }\n);\n\nconst filesSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'files',\n  initialState: {\n    items: [],\n    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n    error: null,\n  },\n  reducers: {},\n  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n    builder\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n        state.status = 'loading';\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'succeeded';\n        state.items = action.payload;\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'failed';\n        state.error = action.payload;\n      });\n  },\n});\n```\n\n**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n\nconst theme = createTheme({\n  palette: {\n    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n  },\n  components: {\n    MuiButton: {\n      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n    },\n  },\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n\n### Authentication & Authorization\n- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n\n### File Management\n- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n\n### Viewing\n- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n\n### Reading Progress\n- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n\n### Ratings\n- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n\n### TTS Processing\n- [ ] User clicks \"Generate Audio\" button to request TTS\n- [ ] System creates TTS job with PENDING status\n- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n\n### Admin Panel\n- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n\n### Error Handling\n- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n- [ ] File not found returns 404\n- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n\n### Performance\n- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n\n---\n\n## 4.1 Guardrails (Prohibitions)\n\n### Scope Guardrails\n- [ ] DO NOT implement features not listed above (no scope creep)\n- [ ] DO NOT add OAuth/SSO - only session-based auth was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT add WebSocket for progress - use polling (REST API chosen)\n- [ ] DO NOT add E2E tests - only unit + integration tests\n- [ ] DO NOT add Docker/containerization unless explicitly requested later\n\n### Architecture Guardrails\n- [ ] DO NOT use JWT tokens - session-based auth was explicitly chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT use React Context for state - Redux Toolkit was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT pre-extract files on upload - on-the-fly extraction was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT store TTS results in separate files - JSON in SQLite was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT add Nginx/CDN - Spring Boot serves everything for MVP\n\n### Code Quality Guardrails\n- [ ] DO NOT create unnecessary abstractions\n- [ ] DO NOT add comments to obvious code\n- [ ] DO NOT add unused dependencies\n- [ ] AVOID over-engineering the LLM fallback (simple try-catch is enough)\n\n### Security Guardrails\n- [ ] NEVER store API keys in plain text - encrypt in database\n- [ ] NEVER expose stack traces to frontend - log and return generic error\n- [ ] NEVER trust user input - validate all inputs\n- [ ] NEVER store passwords in plain text - use bcrypt or similar\n- [ ] DO NOT disable CSRF protection for session-based auth\n\n---\n\n## 5. Reasoning Boundaries\n\n### Follow Existing Patterns\n- Use standard Spring Boot controller/service/repository layering\n- Use Redux Toolkit best practices (slices, async thunks)\n- Use MUI components and theming system\n\n### Avoid Over-Engineering\n- Simple try-catch for LLM fallback, no complex circuit breaker\n- In-memory cache for pages is sufficient (no Redis for MVP)\n- SQLite is adequate for single-server deployment\n- No microservices, keep monolithic\n\n### When Uncertain\n- If OCR prompt doesn't work well, iterate on prompt engineering\n- If Minimax API has issues, document in error message\n- If performance is slow, add indexes to SQLite first\n\n### Boundaries\n- Do NOT implement real-time WebSocket updates (polling is sufficient)\n- Do NOT implement multi-language support initially\n- Do NOT implement file sharing between users\n- Do NOT implement comments or social features\n- Do NOT implement cloud storage (disk only for MVP)\n\n---\n\n## 8. External API Integration Details\n\n### OpenAI Vision API (Primary OCR)\n\n```\nPOST https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions\nHeaders:\n  Authorization: Bearer {API_KEY}\n  Content-Type: application/json\n\nBody:\n{\n  \"model\": \"gpt-4o\",\n  \"messages\": [\n    {\n      \"role\": \"user\",\n      \"content\": [\n        {\n          \"type\": \"text\",\n          \"text\": \"Analyze this comic book page. Extract all text including dialogue and narration. Identify speakers for each dialogue. Return JSON format: {\\\"segments\\\": [{\\\"type\\\": \\\"dialogue|narration\\\", \\\"speaker\\\": \\\"character name or narrator\\\", \\\"text\\\": \\\"the text\\\"}]}\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"type\": \"image_url\",\n          \"image_url\": {\"url\": \"data:image/jpeg;base64,{base64_image}\"}\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n### Claude Vision API (Fallback OCR)\n\n```\nPOST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages\nHeaders:\n  x-api-key: {API_KEY}\n  anthropic-version: 2023-06-01\n  Content-Type: application/json\n\nBody:\n{\n  \"model\": \"claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022\",\n  \"max_tokens\": 4096,\n  \"messages\": [\n    {\n      \"role\": \"user\",\n      \"content\": [\n        {\n          \"type\": \"image\",\n          \"source\": {\n            \"type\": \"base64\",\n            \"media_type\": \"image/jpeg\",\n            \"data\": \"{base64_image}\"\n          }\n        },\n        {\n          \"type\": \"text\",\n          \"text\": \"Analyze this comic book page...\"\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n### Minimax TTS API\n\nRefer to https://www.minimax.io/ documentation for exact API format.
