156→### Database Schema (SQLite)\n   157→\n   158→```sql\n   159→-- Users table\n   160→CREATE TABLE users (\n   161→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   162→    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n   163→    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n   164→    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n   165→    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER', -- 'USER' or 'ADMIN'\n   166→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   167→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   168→);\n   169→\n   170→-- Comic files metadata\n   171→CREATE TABLE comic_files (\n   172→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   173→    filename TEXT NOT NULL,\n   174→    original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,\n   175→    file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n   176→    file_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'CBR' or 'CBZ'\n   177→    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\n   178→    page_count INTEGER NOT NULL,\n   179→    cover_image_path TEXT,\n   180→    uploaded_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n   181→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   182→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   183→);\n   184→\n   185→-- User reading progress (last page only)\n   186→CREATE TABLE reading_progress (\n   187→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   188→    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n   189→    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n   190→    current_page INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n   191→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   192→    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n   193→);\n   194→\n   195→-- User ratings\n   196→CREATE TABLE ratings (\n   197→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   198→    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n   199→    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n   200→    rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5),\n   201→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   202→    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n   203→);\n   204→\n   205→-- TTS processing jobs\n   206→CREATE TABLE tts_jobs (\n   207→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   208→    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n   209→    requested_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n   210→    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED\n   211→    progress INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 0-100\n   212→    current_page INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n   213→    error_message TEXT,\n   214→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   215→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   216→);\n   217→\n   218→-- TTS results stored as JSON in SQLite\n   219→CREATE TABLE tts_results (\n   220→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   221→    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n   222→    page_number INTEGER NOT NULL,\n   223→    ocr_text TEXT, -- Raw extracted text\n   224→    speakers_json TEXT, -- JSON: [{\"speaker\": \"narrator\", \"text\": \"...\", \"audio_path\": \"...\"}]\n   225→    audio_file_path TEXT, -- Combined audio for the page\n   226→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   227→    UNIQUE(file_id, page_number)\n   228→);\n   229→\n   230→-- LLM Configuration (admin-managed)\n   231→CREATE TABLE llm_config (\n   232→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   233→    provider TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'openai', 'claude', 'minimax'\n   234→    api_key_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,\n   235→    model_name TEXT,\n   236→    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n   237→    priority INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- For fallback ordering\n   238→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   239→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   240→);\n   241→\n   242→-- Audit logs\n   243→CREATE TABLE audit_logs (\n   244→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   245→    user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n   246→    action TEXT NOT NULL,\n   247→    entity_type TEXT,\n   248→    entity_id INTEGER,\n   249→    details TEXT, -- JSON\n   250→    ip_address TEXT,\n   251→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   252→);\n   253→\n   254→-- System logs\n   255→CREATE TABLE system_logs (\n   256→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   257→    level TEXT NOT NULL, -- INFO, WARN, ERROR\n   258→    message TEXT NOT NULL,\n   259→    stack_trace TEXT,\n   260→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   261→);\n   262→```\n   263→\n   264→### API Endpoints (REST)\n   265→\n   266→```\n   267→Authentication:\n   268→POST   /api/auth/login          - Login with username/password\n   269→POST   /api/auth/logout         - Logout (invalidate session)\n   270→POST   /api/auth/register       - Register new user\n   271→GET    /api/auth/me             - Get current user info\n   272→\n   273→Files:\n   274→GET    /api/files               - List all files (paginated)\n   275→GET    /api/files/{id}          - Get file metadata\n   276→GET    /api/files/{id}/page/{n} - Get page image (extracted on-the-fly)\n   277→GET    /api/files/{id}/cover    - Get cover image\n   278→POST   /api/files               - Upload new file (multipart)\n   279→DELETE /api/files/{id}          - Delete file (admin only)\n   280→\n   281→Reading Progress:\n   282→GET    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Get current reading position\n   283→PUT    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Update reading position\n   284→\n   285→Ratings:\n   286→GET    /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Get user's rating for file\n   287→POST   /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Rate a file (1-5)\n   288→GET    /api/ratings/{fileId}/avg    - Get average rating\n   289→\n   290→TTS Processing:\n   291→POST   /api/tts/request/{fileId}    - Request TTS processing for file\n   292→GET    /api/tts/status/{jobId}      - Get job status and progress\n   293→GET    /api/tts/result/{fileId}     - Get TTS results for file\n   294→GET    /api/tts/audio/{fileId}/{page} - Stream audio for specific page\n   295→\n   296→Admin:\n   297→GET    /api/admin/users             - List users\n   298→POST   /api/admin/users             - Create user\n   299→PUT    /api/admin/users/{id}        - Update user\n   300→DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}        - Delete user\n   301→GET    /api/admin/files             - List all files (admin view)\n   302→GET    /api/admin/logs              - Get system logs\n   303→GET    /api/admin/audit             - Get audit logs\n   304→GET    /api/admin/llm-config        - Get LLM configurations\n   305→PUT    /api/admin/llm-config/{id}   - Update LLM configuration\n   306→```\n   307→\n   308→---\n   309→\n   310→## 3. Related Code Context\n   311→\n   312→Since this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n   313→\n   314→### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n   315→\n   316→**REST Controller Pattern:**\n   317→```java\n   318→@RestController\n   319→@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\n   320→public class FileController {\n   321→    private final FileService fileService;\n   322→\n   323→    @GetMapping\n   324→    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n   325→        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n   326→    }\n   327→\n   328→    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n   329→    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n   330→        return fileService.findById(id)\n   331→            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n   332→            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n   333→    }\n   334→\n   335→    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n   336→    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n   337→        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n   338→            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n   339→    }\n   340→}\n   341→```\n   342→\n   343→**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n   344→```java\n   345→@Service\n   346→@EnableAsync\n   347→public class TtsService {\n   348→    @Async\n   349→    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n   350→        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n   351→        // For each page:\n   352→        //   1. Extract image from archive\n   353→        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n   354→        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n   355→        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n   356→        //   5. Store result\n   357→        //   6. Update progress\n   358→        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n   359→        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n   360→    }\n   361→}\n   362→```\n   363→\n   364→### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n   365→\n   366→**Slice Pattern:**\n   367→```typescript\n   368→import { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n   369→\n   370→export const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n   371→  'files/fetchAll',\n   372→  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n   373→    try {\n   374→      const response = await api.get('/files');\n   375→      return response.data;\n   376→    } catch (error) {\n   377→      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n   378→    }\n   379→  }\n   380→);\n   381→\n   382→const filesSlice = createSlice({\n   383→  name: 'files',\n   384→  initialState: {\n   385→    items: [],\n   386→    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n   387→    error: null,\n   388→  },\n   389→  reducers: {},\n   390→  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n   391→    builder\n   392→      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n   393→        state.status = 'loading';\n   394→      })\n   395→      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n   396→        state.status = 'succeeded';\n   397→        state.items = action.payload;\n   398→      })\n   399→      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n   400→        state.status = 'failed';\n   401→        state.error = action.payload;\n   402→      });\n   403→  },\n   404→});\n   405→```\n   406→\n   407→**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n   408→```typescript\n   409→import { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n   410→\n   411→const theme = createTheme({\n   412→  palette: {\n   413→    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n   414→    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n   415→    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n   416→  },\n   417→  components: {\n   418→    MuiButton: {\n   419→      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n   420→    },\n   421→  },\n   422→});\n   423→```\n   424→\n   425→---\n   426→\n   427→## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n   428→\n   429→### Authentication & Authorization\n   430→- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n   431→- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n   432→- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n   433→- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n   434→- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n   435→- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n   436→- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n   437→\n   438→### File Management\n   439→- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n   440→- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n   441→- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n   442→- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n   443→- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n   444→- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n   445→- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n   446→\n   447→### Viewing\n   448→- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n   449→- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n   450→- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n   451→- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n   452→- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n   453→- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n   454→\n   455→### Reading Progress\n   456→- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n   457→- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n   458→- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n   459→- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n   460→\n   461→### Ratings\n   462→- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n   463→- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n   464→- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n   465→- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n   466→\n   467→### TTS Processing\n   468→- [ ] User clicks \"Generate Audio\" button to request TTS\n   469→- [ ] System creates TTS job with PENDING status\n   470→- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n   471→- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n   472→- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n   473→- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n   474→- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n   475→- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n   476→- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n   477→- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n   478→- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n   479→- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n   480→\n   481→### Admin Panel\n   482→- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n   483→- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n   484→- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n   485→- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n   486→- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n   487→- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n   488→- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n   489→\n   490→### Error Handling\n   491→- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n   492→- [ ] File not found returns 404\n   493→- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n   494→- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n   495→- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n   496→\n   497→### Performance\n   498→- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n   499→- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n   500→- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n   501→- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n   502→\n   503→---\n   504→\n   505→## 4.1 Guardrails (Prohibitions)\n   506→\n   507→### Scope Guardrails\n   508→- [ ] DO NOT implement features not listed above (no scope creep)\n   509→- [ ] DO NOT add OAuth/SSO - only session-based auth was chosen\n   510→- [ ] DO NOT add WebSocket for progress - use polling (REST API chosen)\n   511→- [ ] DO NOT add E2E tests - only unit + integration tests\n   512→- [ ] DO NOT add Docker/containerization unless explicitly requested later\n   513→\n   514→### Architecture Guardrails\n   515→- [ ] DO NOT use JWT tokens - session-based auth was explicitly chosen\n   516→- [ ] DO NOT use React Context for state - Redux Toolkit was chosen\n   517→- [ ] DO NOT pre-extract files on upload - on-the-fly extraction was chosen\n   518→- [ ] DO NOT store TTS results in separate files - JSON in SQLite was chosen\n   519→- [ ] DO NOT add Nginx/CDN - Spring Boot serves everything for MVP\n   520→\n   521→### Code Quality Guardrails\n   522→- [ ] DO NOT create unnecessary abstractions\n   523→- [ ] DO NOT add comments to obvious code\n   524→- [ ] DO NOT add unused dependencies\n   525→- [ ] AVOID over-engineering the LLM fallback (simple try-catch is enough)\n   526→\n   527→### Security Guardrails\n   528→- [ ] NEVER store API keys in plain text - encrypt in database\n   529→- [ ] NEVER expose stack traces to frontend - log and return generic error\n   530→- [ ] NEVER trust user input - validate all inputs\n   531→- [ ] NEVER store passwords in plain text - use bcrypt or similar\n   532→- [ ] DO NOT disable CSRF protection for session-based auth\n   533→\n   534→---\n   535→\n   536→## 5. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n\n### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n\n**REST Controller Pattern:**\n```java\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\npublic class FileController {\n    private final FileService fileService;\n\n    @GetMapping\n    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n        return fileService.findById(id)\n            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n```java\n@Service\n@EnableAsync\npublic class TtsService {\n    @Async\n    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n        // For each page:\n        //   1. Extract image from archive\n        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n        //   5. Store result\n        //   6. Update progress\n        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n\n**Slice Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n\nexport const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n  'files/fetchAll',\n  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/files');\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n    }\n  }\n);\n\nconst filesSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'files',\n  initialState: {\n    items: [],\n    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n    error: null,\n  },\n  reducers: {},\n  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n    builder\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n        state.status = 'loading';\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'succeeded';\n        state.items = action.payload;\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'failed';\n        state.error = action.payload;\n      });\n  },\n});\n```\n\n**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n\nconst theme = createTheme({\n  palette: {\n    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n  },\n  components: {\n    MuiButton: {\n      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n    },\n  },\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n\n### Authentication & Authorization\n- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n\n### File Management\n- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n\n### Viewing\n- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n\n### Reading Progress\n- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n\n### Ratings\n- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n\n### TTS Processing\n- [ ] User clicks \"Generate Audio\" button to request TTS\n- [ ] System creates TTS job with PENDING status\n- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n\n### Admin Panel\n- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n\n### Error Handling\n- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n- [ ] File not found returns 404\n- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n\n### Performance\n- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n\n---\n\n## 4.1 Guardrails Reasoning Boundaries\n\n### Follow Existing Patterns\n- Use standard Spring Boot controller/service/repository layering\n- Use Redux Toolkit best practices (slices, async thunks)\n- Use MUI components and theming system\n\n### Avoid Over-Engineering\n- Simple try-catch for LLM fallback, no complex circuit breaker\n- In-memory cache for pages is sufficient (no Redis for MVP)\n- SQLite is adequate for single-server deployment\n- No microservices, keep monolithic\n\n### When Uncertain\n- If OCR prompt doesn't work well, iterate on prompt engineering\n- If Minimax API has issues, document in error message\n- If performance is slow, add indexes to SQLite first\n\n### Boundaries\n- Do NOT implement real-time WebSocket updates (polling is sufficient)\n- Do NOT implement multi-language support initially\n- Do NOT implement file sharing between users\n- Do NOT implement comments or social features\n- Do NOT implement cloud storage (disk only for MVP)\n\n---\n\n## 8. 156→### Database Schema (SQLite)\n   157→\n   158→```sql\n   159→-- Users table\n   160→CREATE TABLE users (\n   161→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   162→    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n   163→    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n   164→    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n   165→    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER', -- 'USER' or 'ADMIN'\n   166→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   167→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   168→);\n   169→\n   170→-- Comic files metadata\n   171→CREATE TABLE comic_files (\n   172→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   173→    filename TEXT NOT NULL,\n   174→    original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,\n   175→    file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n   176→    file_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'CBR' or 'CBZ'\n   177→    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\n   178→    page_count INTEGER NOT NULL,\n   179→    cover_image_path TEXT,\n   180→    uploaded_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n   181→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   182→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   183→);\n   184→\n   185→-- User reading progress (last page only)\n   186→CREATE TABLE reading_progress (\n   187→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   188→    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n   189→    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n   190→    current_page INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n   191→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   192→    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n   193→);\n   194→\n   195→-- User ratings\n   196→CREATE TABLE ratings (\n   197→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   198→    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n   199→    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n   200→    rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5),\n   201→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   202→    UNIQUE(user_id, file_id)\n   203→);\n   204→\n   205→-- TTS processing jobs\n   206→CREATE TABLE tts_jobs (\n   207→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   208→    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n   209→    requested_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n   210→    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED\n   211→    progress INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 0-100\n   212→    current_page INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n   213→    error_message TEXT,\n   214→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   215→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   216→);\n   217→\n   218→-- TTS results stored as JSON in SQLite\n   219→CREATE TABLE tts_results (\n   220→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   221→    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n   222→    page_number INTEGER NOT NULL,\n   223→    ocr_text TEXT, -- Raw extracted text\n   224→    speakers_json TEXT, -- JSON: [{\"speaker\": \"narrator\", \"text\": \"...\", \"audio_path\": \"...\"}]\n   225→    audio_file_path TEXT, -- Combined audio for the page\n   226→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   227→    UNIQUE(file_id, page_number)\n   228→);\n   229→\n   230→-- LLM Configuration (admin-managed)\n   231→CREATE TABLE llm_config (\n   232→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   233→    provider TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'openai', 'claude', 'minimax'\n   234→    api_key_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,\n   235→    model_name TEXT,\n   236→    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n   237→    priority INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- For fallback ordering\n   238→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   239→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   240→);\n   241→\n   242→-- Audit logs\n   243→CREATE TABLE audit_logs (\n   244→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   245→    user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n   246→    action TEXT NOT NULL,\n   247→    entity_type TEXT,\n   248→    entity_id INTEGER,\n   249→    details TEXT, -- JSON\n   250→    ip_address TEXT,\n   251→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   252→);\n   253→\n   254→-- System logs\n   255→CREATE TABLE system_logs (\n   256→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   257→    level TEXT NOT NULL, -- INFO, WARN, ERROR\n   258→    message TEXT NOT NULL,\n   259→    stack_trace TEXT,\n   260→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   261→);\n   262→```\n   263→\n   264→### API Endpoints (REST)\n   265→\n   266→```\n   267→Authentication:\n   268→POST   /api/auth/login          - Login with username/password\n   269→POST   /api/auth/logout         - Logout (invalidate List all files (paginated)\n   275→GET    /api/files/{id}          - Get file metadata\n   276→GET    /api/files/{id}/page/{n} - Get page image (extracted on-the-fly)\n   277→GET    /api/files/{id}/cover    - Get cover image\n   278→POST   /api/files               - Upload new file (multipart)\n   279→DELETE /api/files/{id}          - Delete file (admin only)\n   280→\n   281→Reading Progress:\n   282→GET    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Get current reading position\n   283→PUT    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Update reading position\n   284→\n   285→Ratings:\n   286→GET    /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Get user's rating for file\n   287→POST   /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Rate a file (1-5)\n   288→GET    /api/ratings/{fileId}/avg    - Get average rating\n   289→\n   290→TTS Processing:\n   291→POST   /api/tts/request/{fileId}    - Request TTS processing for file\n   292→GET    /api/tts/status/{jobId}      - Get job status and progress\n   293→GET    /api/tts/result/{fileId}     - Get TTS results for file\n   294→GET    /api/tts/audio/{fileId}/{page} - Stream audio for specific page\n   295→\n   296→Admin:\n   297→GET    /api/admin/users             - List users\n   298→POST   /api/admin/users             - Create user\n   299→PUT    /api/admin/users/{id}        - Update user\n   300→DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}        - Delete user\n   301→GET    /api/admin/files             - List all files (admin view)\n   302→GET    /api/admin/logs              - Get system logs\n   303→GET    /api/admin/audit             - Get audit logs\n   304→GET    /api/admin/llm-config        - Get LLM configurations\n   305→PUT    /api/admin/llm-config/{id}   - Update LLM configuration\n   306→```\n   307→\n   308→---\n   309→\n   310→## 3. Related Code Context\n   311→\n   312→Since this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n   313→\n   314→### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n   315→\n   316→**REST Controller Pattern:**\n   317→```java\n   318→@RestController\n   319→@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\n   320→public class FileController {\n   321→    private final FileService fileService;\n   322→\n   323→    @GetMapping\n   324→    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n   325→        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n   326→    }\n   327→\n   328→    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n   329→    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n   330→        return fileService.findById(id)\n   331→            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n   332→            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n   333→    }\n   334→\n   335→    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n   336→    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n   337→        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n   338→            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n   339→    }\n   340→}\n   341→```\n   342→\n   343→**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n   344→```java\n   345→@Service\n   346→@EnableAsync\n   347→public class TtsService {\n   348→    @Async\n   349→    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n   350→        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n   351→        // For each page:\n   352→        //   1. Extract image from archive\n   353→        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n   354→        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n   355→        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n   356→        //   5. Store result\n   357→        //   6. Update progress\n   358→        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n   359→        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n   360→    }\n   361→}\n   362→```\n   363→\n   364→### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n   365→\n   366→**Slice Pattern:**\n   367→```typescript\n   368→import { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n   369→\n   370→export const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n   371→  'files/fetchAll',\n   372→  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n   373→    try {\n   374→      const response = await api.get('/files');\n   375→      return response.data;\n   376→    } catch (error) {\n   377→      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n   378→    }\n   379→  }\n   380→);\n   381→\n   382→const filesSlice = createSlice({\n   383→  name: 'files',\n   384→  initialState: {\n   385→    items: [],\n   386→    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n   387→    error: null,\n   388→  },\n   389→  reducers: {},\n   390→  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n   391→    builder\n   392→      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n   393→        state.status = 'loading';\n   394→      })\n   395→      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n   396→        state.status = 'succeeded';\n   397→        state.items = action.payload;\n   398→      })\n   399→      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n   400→        state.status = 'failed';\n   401→        state.error = action.payload;\n   402→      });\n   403→  },\n   404→});\n   405→```\n   406→\n   407→**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n   408→```typescript\n   409→import { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n   410→\n   411→const theme = createTheme({\n   412→  palette: {\n   413→    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n   414→    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n   415→    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n   416→  },\n   417→  components: {\n   418→    MuiButton: {\n   419→      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n   420→    },\n   421→  },\n   422→});\n   423→```\n   424→\n   425→---\n   426→\n   427→## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n   428→\n   429→### Authentication & Authorization\n   430→- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n   431→- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n   432→- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n   433→- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n   434→- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n   435→- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n   436→- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n   437→\n   438→### File Management\n   439→- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n   440→- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n   441→- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n   442→- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n   443→- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n   444→- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n   445→- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n   446→\n   447→### Viewing\n   448→- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n   449→- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n   450→- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n   451→- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n   452→- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n   453→- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n   454→\n   455→### Reading Progress\n   456→- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n   457→- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n   458→- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n   459→- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n   460→\n   461→### Ratings\n   462→- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n   463→- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n   464→- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n   465→- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n   466→\n   467→### TTS Processing\n   468→- [ ] User clicks \"Generate Audio\" button to request TTS\n   469→- [ ] System creates TTS job with PENDING status\n   470→- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n   471→- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n   472→- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n   473→- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n   474→- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n   475→- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n   476→- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n   477→- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n   478→- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n   479→- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n   480→\n   481→### Admin Panel\n   482→- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n   483→- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n   484→- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n   485→- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n   486→- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n   487→- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n   488→- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n   489→\n   490→### Error Handling\n   491→- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n   492→- [ ] File not found returns 404\n   493→- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n   494→- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n   495→- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n   496→\n   497→### Performance\n   498→- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n   499→- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n   500→- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n   501→- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n   502→\n   503→---\n   504→\n   505→## 4.1 Guardrails (Prohibitions)\n   506→\n   507→### Scope Guardrails\n   508→- [ ] DO NOT implement features not listed above (no scope creep)\n   509→- [ ] DO NOT add OAuth/SSO - only session-based auth was chosen\n   510→- [ ] DO NOT add WebSocket for progress - use polling (REST API chosen)\n   511→- [ ] DO NOT add E2E tests - only unit + integration tests\n   512→- [ ] DO NOT add Docker/containerization unless explicitly requested later\n   513→\n   514→### Architecture Guardrails\n   515→- [ ] DO NOT use JWT tokens - session-based auth was explicitly chosen\n   516→- [ ] DO NOT use React Context for state - Redux Toolkit was chosen\n   517→- [ ] DO NOT pre-extract files on upload - on-the-fly extraction was chosen\n   518→- [ ] DO NOT store TTS results in separate files - JSON in SQLite was chosen\n   519→- [ ] DO NOT add Nginx/CDN - Spring Boot serves everything for MVP\n   520→\n   521→### Code Quality Guardrails\n   522→- [ ] DO NOT create unnecessary abstractions\n   523→- [ ] DO NOT add comments to obvious code\n   524→- [ ] DO NOT add unused dependencies\n   525→- [ ] AVOID over-engineering the LLM fallback (simple try-catch is enough)\n   526→\n   527→### Security Guardrails\n   528→- [ ] NEVER store API keys in plain text - encrypt in database\n   529→- [ ] NEVER expose stack traces to frontend - log and return generic error\n   530→- [ ] NEVER trust user input - validate all inputs\n   531→- [ ] NEVER store passwords in plain text - use bcrypt or similar\n   532→- [ ] DO NOT disable CSRF protection for session-based auth\n   533→\n   534→---\n   535→\n   536→## 5. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n\n### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n\n**REST Controller Pattern:**\n```java\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\npublic class FileController {\n    private final FileService fileService;\n\n    @GetMapping\n    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n        return fileService.findById(id)\n            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n```java\n@Service\n@EnableAsync\npublic class TtsService {\n    @Async\n    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n        // For each page:\n        //   1. Extract image from archive\n        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n        //   5. Store result\n        //   6. Update progress\n        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n\n**Slice Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n\nexport const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n  'files/fetchAll',\n  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/files');\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n    }\n  }\n);\n\nconst filesSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'files',\n  initialState: {\n    items: [],\n    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n    error: null,\n  },\n  reducers: {},\n  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n    builder\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n        state.status = 'loading';\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'succeeded';\n        state.items = action.payload;\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'failed';\n        state.error = action.payload;\n      });\n  },\n});\n```\n\n**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n\nconst theme = createTheme({\n  palette: {\n    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n  },\n  components: {\n    MuiButton: {\n      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n    },\n  },\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n\n### Authentication & Authorization\n- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n\n### File Management\n- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n\n### Viewing\n- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n\n### Reading Progress\n- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n\n### Ratings\n- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n\n### TTS Processing\n- [ ] User clicks \"Generate Audio\" button to request TTS\n- [ ] System creates TTS job with PENDING status\n- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n\n### Admin Panel\n- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n\n### Error Handling\n- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n- [ ] File not found returns 404\n- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n\n### Performance\n- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n\n---\n\n## 4.1 Guardrails (Prohibitions)\n\n### Scope Guardrails\n- [ ] DO NOT implement features not listed above (no scope creep)\n- [ ] DO NOT add OAuth/SSO - only session-based auth was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT add WebSocket for progress - use polling (REST API chosen)\n- [ ] DO NOT add E2E tests - only unit + integration tests\n- [ ] DO NOT add Docker/containerization unless explicitly requested later\n\n### Architecture Guardrails\n- [ ] DO NOT use JWT tokens - session-based auth was explicitly chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT use React Context for state - Redux Toolkit was chosen\n- [ ] DO NOT pre-extract files on upload - Related Code Context\n   311→\n   312→Since this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n   313→\n   314→### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n   315→\n   316→**REST Controller Pattern:**\n   317→```java\n   318→@RestController\n   319→@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\n   320→public class FileController {\n   321→    private final FileService fileService;\n   322→\n   323→    @GetMapping\n   324→    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n   325→        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n   326→    }\n   327→\n   328→    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n   329→    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n   330→        return fileService.findById(id)\n   331→            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n   332→            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n   333→    }\n   334→\n   335→    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n   336→    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n   337→        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n   338→            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n   339→    }\n   340→}\n   341→```\n   342→\n   343→**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n   344→```java\n   345→@Service\n   346→@EnableAsync\n   347→public class TtsService {\n   348→    @Async\n   349→    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n   350→        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n   351→        // For each page:\n   352→        //   1. Extract image from archive\n   353→        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n   354→        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n   355→        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n   356→        //   5. Store result\n   357→        //   6. Update progress\n   358→        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n   359→        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n   360→    }\n   361→}\n   362→```\n   363→\n   364→### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n   365→\n   366→**Slice Pattern:**\n   367→```typescript\n   368→import { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n   369→\n   370→export const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n   371→  'files/fetchAll',\n   372→  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n   373→    try {\n   374→      const response = await api.get('/files');\n   375→      return response.data;\n   376→    } catch (error) {\n   377→      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n   378→    }\n   379→  }\n   380→);\n   381→\n   382→const filesSlice = createSlice({\n   383→  name: 'files',\n   384→  initialState: {\n   385→    items: [],\n   386→    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n   387→    error: null,\n   388→  },\n   389→  reducers: {},\n   390→  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n   391→    builder\n   392→      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n   393→        state.status = 'loading';\n   394→      })\n   395→      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n   396→        state.status = 'succeeded';\n   397→        state.items = action.payload;\n   398→      })\n   399→      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n   400→        state.status = 'failed';\n   401→        state.error = action.payload;\n   402→      });\n   403→  },\n   404→});\n   405→```\n   406→\n   407→**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n   408→```typescript\n   409→import { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n   410→\n   411→const theme = createTheme({\n   412→  palette: {\n   413→    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n   414→    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n   415→    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n   416→  },\n   417→  components: {\n   418→    MuiButton: Related Code Context\n\nSince this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n\n### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n\n**REST Controller Pattern:**\n```java\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\npublic class FileController {\n    private final FileService fileService;\n\n    @GetMapping\n    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n        return fileService.findById(id)\n            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n```java\n@Service\n@EnableAsync\npublic class TtsService {\n    @Async\n    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n        // For each page:\n        //   1. Extract image from archive\n        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n        //   5. Store result\n        //   6. Update progress\n        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n\n**Slice Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n\nexport const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n  'files/fetchAll',\n  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/files');\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n    }\n  }\n);\n\nconst filesSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'files',\n  initialState: {\n    items: [],\n    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n    error: null,\n  },\n  reducers: {},\n  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n    builder\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n        state.status = 'loading';\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'succeeded';\n        state.items = action.payload;\n      })\n      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n        state.status = 'failed';\n        state.error = action.payload;\n      });\n  },\n});\n```\n\n**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n```typescript\nimport { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n\nconst theme = createTheme({\n  palette: {\n    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n  },\n  components: {\n    MuiButton: {\n      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n    },\n  },\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n\n### Authentication & Authorization\n- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n\n### File Management\n- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n\n### Viewing\n- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n\n### Reading Progress\n- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n\n### Ratings\n- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n\n### TTS Processing\n- [ ] User clicks \"Generate Audio\" button to request TTS\n- [ ] System creates TTS job with PENDING status\n- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n\n### Admin Panel\n- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n\n### Error Handling\n- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n- [ ] File not found returns 404\n- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n\n### Performance\n- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n\n---\n\n## 4.1 Guardrails 210→    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED\n   211→    progress INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 0-100\n   212→    current_page INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n   213→    error_message TEXT,\n   214→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   215→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   216→);\n   217→\n   218→-- TTS results stored as JSON in SQLite\n   219→CREATE TABLE tts_results (\n   220→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   221→    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comic_files(id),\n   222→    page_number INTEGER NOT NULL,\n   223→    ocr_text TEXT, -- Raw extracted text\n   224→    speakers_json TEXT, -- JSON: [{\"speaker\": \"narrator\", \"text\": \"...\", \"audio_path\": \"...\"}]\n   225→    audio_file_path TEXT, -- Combined audio for the page\n   226→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   227→    UNIQUE(file_id, page_number)\n   228→);\n   229→\n   230→-- LLM Configuration (admin-managed)\n   231→CREATE TABLE llm_config (\n   232→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   233→    provider TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'openai', 'claude', 'minimax'\n   234→    api_key_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,\n   235→    model_name TEXT,\n   236→    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n   237→    priority INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- For fallback ordering\n   238→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n   239→    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   240→);\n   241→\n   242→-- Audit logs\n   243→CREATE TABLE audit_logs (\n   244→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   245→    user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n   246→    action TEXT NOT NULL,\n   247→    entity_type TEXT,\n   248→    entity_id INTEGER,\n   249→    details TEXT, -- JSON\n   250→    ip_address TEXT,\n   251→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   252→);\n   253→\n   254→-- System logs\n   255→CREATE TABLE system_logs (\n   256→    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n   257→    level TEXT NOT NULL, -- INFO, WARN, ERROR\n   258→    message TEXT NOT NULL,\n   259→    stack_trace TEXT,\n   260→    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n   261→);\n   262→```\n   263→\n   264→### API Endpoints (REST)\n   265→\n   266→```\n   267→Authentication:\n   268→POST   /api/auth/login          - Login with username/password\n   269→POST   /api/auth/logout         - Logout (invalidate List all files (paginated)\n   275→GET    /api/files/{id}          - Get file metadata\n   276→GET    /api/files/{id}/page/{n} - Get page image (extracted on-the-fly)\n   277→GET    /api/files/{id}/cover    - Get cover image\n   278→POST   /api/files               - Upload new file (multipart)\n   279→DELETE /api/files/{id}          - Delete file (admin only)\n   280→\n   281→Reading Progress:\n   282→GET    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Get current reading position\n   283→PUT    /api/progress/{fileId}       - Update reading position\n   284→\n   285→Ratings:\n   286→GET    /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Get user's rating for file\n   287→POST   /api/ratings/{fileId}        - Rate a file (1-5)\n   288→GET    /api/ratings/{fileId}/avg    - Get average rating\n   289→\n   290→TTS Processing:\n   291→POST   /api/tts/request/{fileId}    - Request TTS processing for file\n   292→GET    /api/tts/status/{jobId}      - Get job status and progress\n   293→GET    /api/tts/result/{fileId}     - Get TTS results for file\n   294→GET    /api/tts/audio/{fileId}/{page} - Stream audio for specific page\n   295→\n   296→Admin:\n   297→GET    /api/admin/users             - List users\n   298→POST   /api/admin/users             - Create user\n   299→PUT    /api/admin/users/{id}        - Update user\n   300→DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}        - Delete user\n   301→GET    /api/admin/files             - List all files (admin view)\n   302→GET    /api/admin/logs              - Get system logs\n   303→GET    /api/admin/audit             - Get audit logs\n   304→GET    /api/admin/llm-config        - Get LLM configurations\n   305→PUT    /api/admin/llm-config/{id}   - Update LLM configuration\n   306→```\n   307→\n   308→---\n   309→\n   310→## 3. Related Code Context\n   311→\n   312→Since this is a **greenfield project**, there is no existing code. However, follow these patterns from Context7 research:\n   313→\n   314→### Spring Boot Patterns to Follow\n   315→\n   316→**REST Controller Pattern:**\n   317→```java\n   318→@RestController\n   319→@RequestMapping(\"/api/files\")\n   320→public class FileController {\n   321→    private final FileService fileService;\n   322→\n   323→    @GetMapping\n   324→    public ResponseEntity<Page<FileDto>> getAllFiles(Pageable pageable) {\n   325→        return ResponseEntity.ok(fileService.findAll(pageable));\n   326→    }\n   327→\n   328→    @GetMapping(\"/{id}\")\n   329→    public ResponseEntity<FileDto> getFile(@PathVariable Long id) {\n   330→        return fileService.findById(id)\n   331→            .map(ResponseEntity::ok)\n   332→            .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());\n   333→    }\n   334→\n   335→    @ExceptionHandler(FileNotFoundException.class)\n   336→    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(FileNotFoundException ex) {\n   337→        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)\n   338→            .body(new ErrorResponse(\"File not found\", ex.getMessage()));\n   339→    }\n   340→}\n   341→```\n   342→\n   343→**Async Processing Pattern (for TTS):**\n   344→```java\n   345→@Service\n   346→@EnableAsync\n   347→public class TtsService {\n   348→    @Async\n   349→    public CompletableFuture<TtsResult> processFile(Long fileId, Long jobId) {\n   350→        // Update job status to PROCESSING\n   351→        // For each page:\n   352→        //   1. Extract image from archive\n   353→        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n   354→        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n   355→        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n   356→        //   5. Store result\n   357→        //   6. Update progress\n   358→        // Update job status to COMPLETED\n   359→        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(result);\n   360→    }\n   361→}\n   362→```\n   363→\n   364→### React + Redux Toolkit Patterns to Follow\n   365→\n   366→**Slice Pattern:**\n   367→```typescript\n   368→import { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\n   369→\n   370→export const fetchFiles = createAsyncThunk(\n   371→  'files/fetchAll',\n   372→  async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => {\n   373→    try {\n   374→      const response = await api.get('/files');\n   375→      return response.data;\n   376→    } catch (error) {\n   377→      return rejectWithValue(error.response?.data);\n   378→    }\n   379→  }\n   380→);\n   381→\n   382→const filesSlice = createSlice({\n   383→  name: 'files',\n   384→  initialState: {\n   385→    items: [],\n   386→    status: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'\n   387→    error: null,\n   388→  },\n   389→  reducers: {},\n   390→  extraReducers: (builder) => {\n   391→    builder\n   392→      .addCase(fetchFiles.pending, (state) => {\n   393→        state.status = 'loading';\n   394→      })\n   395→      .addCase(fetchFiles.fulfilled, (state, action) => {\n   396→        state.status = 'succeeded';\n   397→        state.items = action.payload;\n   398→      })\n   399→      .addCase(fetchFiles.rejected, (state, action) => {\n   400→        state.status = 'failed';\n   401→        state.error = action.payload;\n   402→      });\n   403→  },\n   404→});\n   405→```\n   406→\n   407→**MUI Theme Pattern:**\n   408→```typescript\n   409→import { createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';\n   410→\n   411→const theme = createTheme({\n   412→  palette: {\n   413→    mode: 'dark', // Comic readers often prefer dark mode\n   414→    primary: { main: '#1976d2' },\n   415→    secondary: { main: '#dc004e' },\n   416→  },\n   417→  components: {\n   418→    MuiButton: {\n   419→      defaultProps: { variant: 'contained' },\n   420→    },\n   421→  },\n   422→});\n   423→```\n   424→\n   425→---\n   426→\n   427→## 4. Acceptance Criteria\n   428→\n   429→### Authentication & Authorization\n   430→- [ ] Users can register with username, email, and password\n   431→- [ ] Users can login with username/password\n   432→- [ ] Session is maintained via HTTP-only secure cookie\n   433→- [ ] Session expires after configurable timeout (default: 24 hours)\n   434→- [ ] Unauthorized requests return 401\n   435→- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admin users\n   436→- [ ] Logout invalidates server-side session\n   437→\n   438→### File Management\n   439→- [ ] Admin can upload CBR/CBZ files via multipart form\n   440→- [ ] System extracts and counts pages on upload\n   441→- [ ] System generates/extracts cover image on upload\n   442→- [ ] Files are stored on disk with unique filenames (UUID)\n   443→- [ ] File metadata stored in SQLite\n   444→- [ ] Admin can delete files (also removes from disk)\n   445→- [ ] Users can browse files in a grid/list view\n   446→\n   447→### Viewing\n   448→- [ ] Page-by-page mode: displays one page at a time with prev/next navigation\n   449→- [ ] Scrolling mode: displays all pages in vertical scroll (lazy loaded)\n   450→- [ ] Fullscreen mode available in both viewing modes\n   451→- [ ] Keyboard navigation: arrow keys for prev/next, ESC for exit fullscreen\n   452→- [ ] Pages extracted on-the-fly from archive (with caching)\n   453→- [ ] Responsive images that fit viewport\n   454→\n   455→### Reading Progress\n   456→- [ ] Current page saved automatically when user navigates\n   457→- [ ] Progress stored per user per file (unique constraint)\n   458→- [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n   459→- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n   460→\n   461→### Ratings\n   462→- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n   463→- [ ] Rating updates if user re-rates\n   464→- [ ] Average rating displayed on file cards\n   465→- [ ] Only authenticated users can rate\n   466→\n   467→### TTS Processing\n   468→- [ ] User clicks \"Generate Audio\" button to request TTS\n   469→- [ ] System creates TTS job with PENDING status\n   470→- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n   471→- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n   472→- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n   473→- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n   474→- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n   475→- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n   476→- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n   477→- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n   478→- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n   479→- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n   480→\n   481→### Admin Panel\n   482→- [ ] Only accessible to users with ADMIN role\n   483→- [ ] User Management: list, create, update, delete users\n   484→- [ ] File Management: list, delete files, view upload stats\n   485→- [ ] Logs: view system logs (filterable by level, date)\n   486→- [ ] Audit Logs: view user actions (who did what when)\n   487→- [ ] LLM Config: manage API keys for OpenAI, Claude, Minimax\n   488→- [ ] API keys stored encrypted in database\n   489→\n   490→### Error Handling\n   491→- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n   492→- [ ] File not found returns 404\n   493→- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n   494→- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n   495→- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n   496→\n   497→### Performance\n   498→- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n   499→- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n   500→- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n   501→- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n   502→\n   503→---\n   504→\n   505→## 4.1 Guardrails (Prohibitions)\n   506→\n   507→### Scope Guardrails\n   508→- [ ] DO NOT implement features not listed above (no scope creep)\n   509→- [ ] DO NOT add OAuth/SSO - only session-based auth was chosen\n   510→- [ ] DO NOT add WebSocket for progress - use polling (REST API chosen)\n   511→- [ ] DO NOT add E2E tests - only unit + integration tests\n   512→- [ ] DO NOT add Docker/containerization unless explicitly requested later\n   513→\n   514→### Architecture Guardrails\n   515→- [ ] DO NOT use JWT tokens - session-based auth was explicitly chosen\n   516→- [ ] DO NOT use React Context for state - Redux Toolkit was chosen\n   517→- [ ] DO NOT pre-extract files on upload - on-the-fly extraction was chosen\n   518→- [ ] DO NOT store TTS results in separate files - JSON in SQLite was chosen\n   519→- [ ] DO NOT add Nginx/CDN - Spring Boot serves everything for MVP\n   520→\n   521→### Code Quality Guardrails\n   522→- [ ] DO NOT create unnecessary abstractions\n   523→- [ ] DO NOT add comments to obvious code\n   524→- [ ] DO NOT add unused dependencies\n   525→- [ ] AVOID over-engineering the LLM fallback (simple try-catch is enough)\n   526→\n   527→### Security Guardrails\n   528→- [ ] NEVER store API keys in plain text - encrypt in database\n   529→- [ ] NEVER expose stack traces to frontend - log and return generic error\n   530→- [ ] NEVER trust user input - validate all inputs\n   531→- [ ] NEVER store passwords in plain text - use bcrypt or similar\n   532→- [ ] DO NOT disable CSRF protection for session-based auth\n   533→\n   534→---\n   535→\n   536→## 5. Reasoning Boundaries\n   712→\n   713→### Follow Existing Patterns\n   714→- Use standard Spring Boot controller/service/repository layering\n   715→- Use Redux Toolkit best practices (slices, async thunks)\n   716→- Use MUI components and theming system\n   717→\n   718→### Avoid Over-Engineering\n   719→- Simple try-catch for LLM fallback, no complex circuit breaker\n   720→- In-memory cache for pages is sufficient (no Redis for MVP)\n   721→- SQLite is adequate for single-server deployment\n   722→- No microservices, keep monolithic\n   723→\n   724→### When Uncertain\n   725→- If OCR prompt doesn't work well, iterate on prompt engineering\n   726→- If Minimax API has issues, document in error message\n   727→- If performance is slow, add indexes to SQLite first\n   728→\n   729→### Boundaries\n   730→- Do NOT implement real-time WebSocket updates (polling is sufficient)\n   731→- Do NOT implement multi-language support initially\n   732→- Do NOT implement file sharing between users\n   733→- Do NOT implement comments or social features\n   734→- Do NOT implement cloud storage (disk only for MVP)\n   735→\n   736→---\n   737→\n   738→## 8. External API Integration Details\n   739→\n   740→### OpenAI Vision API (Primary OCR)\n   741→\n   742→```\n   743→POST https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions\n   744→Headers:\n   745→  Authorization: Bearer {API_KEY}\n   746→  Content-Type: application/json\n   747→\n   748→Body:\n   749→{\n   750→  \"model\": \"gpt-4o\",\n   751→  \"messages\": [\n   752→    {\n   753→      \"role\": \"user\",\n   754→      \"content\": [\n   755→        {\n   756→          \"type\": \"text\",\n   757→          \"text\": \"Analyze this comic book page. Extract all text including dialogue and narration. Identify speakers for each dialogue. Extract image from archive\n        //   2. Send to LLM for OCR\n        //   3. Parse speakers from OCR result\n        //   4. Generate audio via Minimax\n        //   5. Store result\n        //   6. [ ] When opening a file, resume from last position\n- [ ] Only stores last page number (not scroll position)\n\n### Ratings\n- [ ] Users can rate files 1-5 stars\n- [ ] Rating updates if user TTS job with PENDING status\n- [ ] Job processes asynchronously in background\n- [ ] Progress updates as each page is processed (0-100%)\n- [ ] User can poll job status endpoint for progress\n- [ ] OCR via OpenAI Vision API (primary), fallback to Claude Vision\n- [ ] OCR identifies dialogue, narration, and speakers\n- [ ] TTS generates audio per speaker using Minimax API\n- [ ] Results stored as JSON in SQLite\n- [ ] Audio files stored on disk\n- [ ] User can play audio per page after processing complete\n- [ ] Error handling: if OCR/TTS fails, job marked FAILED with error message\n\n### database\n\n### Error Handling\n- [ ] Invalid file format returns 400 with clear message\n- [ ] File not found returns 404\n- [ ] Server errors return 500 with generic message (details logged)\n- [ ] Frontend displays user-friendly error messages\n- [ ] All errors logged to system_logs table\n\n### Performance\n- [ ] Page images cached after first extraction (in-memory or disk cache)\n- [ ] Lazy loading for scroll mode (load pages as user scrolls)\n- [ ] Pagination for file lists (default 20 per page)\n- [ ] SQLite optimized with proper indexes\n\n---\n\n## 4.1 Guardrails Reasoning Boundaries\n\n### Follow Existing Patterns\n- Use standard Spring Boot controller/service/repository layering\n- Use Redux Toolkit best practices (slices, async thunks)\n- Use MUI components and theming system\n\n### Avoid Over-Engineering\n- Simple try-catch for LLM fallback, no complex circuit breaker\n- In-memory cache for pages is sufficient (no Redis for MVP)\n- SQLite is adequate for single-server deployment\n- No microservices, keep monolithic\n\n### When Uncertain\n- If OCR prompt doesn't work well, iterate on prompt engineering\n- If Minimax API has issues, document in error message\n- If performance is slow, add indexes to SQLite first\n\n### Boundaries\n- Do NOT implement real-time WebSocket updates (polling is sufficient)\n- Do NOT implement multi-language support initially\n- Do NOT implement file sharing between users\n- Do NOT implement comments or social features\n- Do NOT implement cloud storage (disk only for MVP)\n\n---\n\n## 8.
